_about: The phases of forge, read by gate.py. modes: the phases of each mode, in order. optional: may be skipped with the user's reason; secure never. added: newer than some projects, so a state from before them records neither and is not damaged. asks: auto mode never records these, the go is the user's own each time. parts: the skill that holds each phase as a part (its steps are in ../forge-<skill>/steps/<phase>.md); a phase that is not listed is a skill of its own, forge-<phase>.
